# webrtlsdr (low-level part)

The RTL-SDR driver files (`rtlsdr.js`, `errors.js`, `rtlsdr/`) from [webrtlsdr](https://github.com/jtarrio/webrtlsdr) by Jacobo Tarrio, npm package `@jtarrio/webrtlsdr` version 3.0.6, `dist/` folder, unmodified apart from removing the source map comments. Licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (see `LICENSE`).

Used by `docs/qso/sources/rtlsdr.js` to read IQ samples from an RTL-SDR (RTL2832U with an R820T/R828D tuner, including the RTL-SDR Blog V3 and V4) over WebUSB.
